item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Sanba will move towards the vicinity of Beibu Wan in the next couple of days, and linger over the region. Its outer rainbands will affect the coast of Guangdong. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Friday, bringing rainy weather to the region. It will also be slightly cooler over the coast of Guangdong in the morning and at night during the weekend and early next week. With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China next week.
